arxiv-2101-03626.title: On the RND under Heston’s stochastic volatility model
arxiv-2101-03626.creator: Ben Boukai
arxiv-2101-03626.description: Abstract We consider Heston’s (1993) stochastic volatility model for valuation of European options to which (semi) closed form solutions are available and are given in terms of characteristic functions. We prove that the class of scale-parameter distributions with mean being the forward spot price satisfies Heston’s solution.

arxiv-2102-04637.title: On the theory of charge transport and entropic effects in solvated molecular junctions
arxiv-2102-04637.creator: Jakub K. Sowa, Rudolph A. Marcus
arxiv-2102-04637.description: Abstract Experimental studies on single-molecule junctions are typically in need of a simple theoretical approach that can reproduce or be fitted to experimentally measured transport data. In this context, the single-level variant of the Landauer approach is most commonly used but methods based on Marcus theory are also gaining in popularity.

arxiv-2104-03447.title: Boundary layer solution of the Boltzmann equation for diffusive reflection boundary conditions in half-space
arxiv-2104-03447.creator: Feimin Huang, Yong Wang
arxiv-2104-03447.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Feimin Huang, Yong Wang. We study steady Boltzmann equation in half-space, which arises in the Knudsen boundary layer problem, with diffusive reflection boundary conditions. Under certain admissible conditions and the source term decaying exponentially, we establish the existence of boundary layer solution for both linear and nonlinear Boltzmann equation in half-space with diffusive reflection boundary condition in L x , v ∞ L^{\infty}_{x,v} when the far-field Mach number of the Maxwellian is zero. The continuity and the spacial decay of the solution are obtained.

arxiv-2201-00310.title: On a family of elliptic curves of rank at least 2 2
arxiv-2201-00310.creator: Kalyan Chakraborty and Richa Sharma
arxiv-2201-00310.description: Abstract . Let C m : y 2 = x 3 − m 2 ​ x + p 2 ​ q 2 C_{m}:y^{2}=x^{3}-m^{2}x+p^{2}q^{2} be a family of elliptic curves over ℚ \mathbb{Q} , where m m is a positive integer and p , q p,q are distinct odd primes.

arxiv-2204-14255.title: Human-in-the-loop online multi-agent approach to increase trustworthiness in ML models through trust scores and data augmentation
arxiv-2204-14255.creator: Peini Liu 1 2 , Jordi Guitart 1 2 , Ajay Dholakia 3 , David Ellison 3 , Miroslav Hodak 3
arxiv-2204-14255.description: Abstract Increasing a ML model accuracy is not enough, we must also increase its trustworthiness. This is an important step for building resilient AI systems for safety-critical applications such as automotive, finance, and healthcare. For that purpose, we propose a multi-agent system that combines both machine and human agents.

arxiv-2208-08687.title: Incidental Data: Observation of Privacy Compromising Data on Social Media Platforms
arxiv-2208-08687.creator: Stefan Kutschera
arxiv-2208-08687.description: Abstract Social media plays an important role for a vast majority in one’s internet life. Likewise, sharing, publishing and posting content through social media became nearly effortless. This unleashes new threats as unintentionally shared information may be used against oneself or beloved ones.

arxiv-2211-10491.title: Rocky histories: The effect of high excitations on the formation of rocky planets astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , SyMBA ( Duncan et al. 1998 )
arxiv-2211-10491.creator: Jennifer Scora, Diana Valencia, Alessandro Morbidelli, Seth Jacobson
arxiv-2211-10491.description: Abstract Rocky planets both in and outside of our solar system are observed to have a range of core-mass fractions (CMFs). Imperfect collisions can preferentially strip mantle material from a planet, changing its CMF, and are therefore thought to be the most likely cause of this observed CMF variation.

arxiv-2307-04205.title: Extending the Forward Forward Algorithm
arxiv-2307-04205.creator: Saumya Gandhi, Ritu Gala, Jonah Kornberg, Advaith Sridhar
arxiv-2307-04205.description: Abstract The Forward Forward algorithm, proposed by Geoffrey Hinton in November 2022, is a novel method for training neural networks as an alternative to backpropagation. In this project, we replicate Hinton’s experiments on the MNIST dataset, and subsequently extend the scope of the method with two significant contributions.

arxiv-2309-03105.title: The Secrets of Non-Blind Poisson Deconvolution
arxiv-2309-03105.creator: Abhiram Gnanasambandam, and Yash Sanghvi, and Stanley H. Chan
arxiv-2309-03105.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Abhiram Gnanasambandam, and Yash Sanghvi, and Stanley H. Chan. Non-blind image deconvolution has been studied for several decades but most of the existing work focuses on blur instead of noise. In photon-limited conditions, however, the excessive amount of shot noise makes traditional deconvolution algorithms fail. In searching for reasons why these methods fail, we present a systematic analysis of the Poisson non-blind deconvolution algorithms reported in the literature, covering both classical and deep learning methods.

arxiv-2401-03810.title: Time Delay in κ \kappa -Anti-de Sitter Spacetime Journal: Physics Letters B
arxiv-2401-03810.creator: Iarley P. Lobo
arxiv-2401-03810.description: Abstract Based on deformed translations in the κ \kappa -anti-de Sitter algebra, we derive a delay in the time of detection between a soft and a hard photon, which are simultaneously emitted at a distant event, to first order in the quantum gravity parameter.

arxiv-2402-14637.title: Upper Limits of 44 Ti Decay Emission in Four Nearby Thermonuclear Supernova Remnants 2023 Upper Limits of 44 Ti Decay Emission in Four Nearby Thermonuclear Supernova Remnants – 12
arxiv-2402-14637.creator: Jianbin Weng, Ping Zhou, Hagai B. Perets, Daniel R. Wik, Yang Chen
arxiv-2402-14637.description: Abstract To identify progenitors and investigate evidence of He burning, we searched for decay radiation of freshly synthesized 44 Ti in four young nearby thermonuclear supernova remnants: Kepler, SN 1885, G1.9+0.3 and SN 1006, by analysing the up-to-date NuSTAR archival data.

arxiv-2403-16670.title: Probabilistic bivariate Bell polynomials
arxiv-2403-16670.creator: Taekyun Kim, Dae San Kim
arxiv-2403-16670.description: Abstract . Let Y Y be a random variable whose moment generating function exists in some neighborhood of the origin. We consider the probabilistic bivariate Bell polynomials associated with Y Y and the probabilistic bivariate r r -Bell polynomials associated with Y Y .

arxiv-2407-04097.title: Simulating FRB Morphologies and Coherent Phase Correlation Signatures from Multi-Plane Astrophysical Lensing
arxiv-2407-04097.creator: Zarif Kader, Matt Dobbs, Calvin Leung, Kiyoshi W. Masui, Mawson W. Sammons
arxiv-2407-04097.description: Abstract Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs), like pulsars, display radio emission from compact regions such that they can be treated as point sources. As this radiation propagates through space, they encounter sources of lensing such as a gravitational field of massive objects or inhomogeneous changes in the electron density of cold plasma.

arxiv-2409-01913.title: Stable determination of a time-dependent matrix potential for a wave equation in an infinite waveguide
arxiv-2409-01913.creator: Nitesh Kumar † , Tanmay Sarkar ‡ and Manmohan Vashisth ∗
arxiv-2409-01913.description: Abstract . We analyze the stability of an inverse problem for determining the time-dependent matrix potential appearing in the Dirichlet initial-boundary value problem for the wave equation in an unbounded cylindrical waveguide. The observation is given by the input-output map associated with the wave equation.

arxiv-2503-08777.title: The COSMOS-Web Lens Survey (COWLS) I: Discovery of >100 high redshift strong lenses in contiguous JWST imaging
arxiv-2503-08777.creator: James W. Nightingale, Guillaume Mahler, Jacqueline McCleary, Qiuhan He, Natalie B. Hogg, Aristeidis Amvrosiadis, Ghassem Gozaliasl, Wilfried Mercier, Diana Scognamiglio, Edward Berman, Gavin Leroy, Daizhong Liu, Richard J. Massey Marko Shuntov, Maximilian von Wietersheim-Kramsta, Maximilien Franco,
arxiv-2503-08777.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by James W. Nightingale, Guillaume Mahler, Jacqueline McCleary, Qiuhan He, Natalie B. Hogg, Aristeidis Amvrosiadis, Ghassem Gozaliasl, Wilfried Mercier, Diana Scognamiglio, Edward Berman, Gavin Leroy, Daizhong Liu, Richard J. Massey Marko Shuntov, Maximilian von Wietersheim-Kramsta, Maximilien Franco, . We present the COSMOS-Web Lens Survey (COWLS), a sample of over 100 strong lens candidates from the 0.54 0.54 deg 2 COSMOS-Web survey, discovered using exquisite James Webb Space Telescope ( JWST ) imaging across four wavebands.

arxiv-2505-16138.title: Multimodal Online Federated Learning with Modality Missing in Internet of Things
arxiv-2505-16138.creator: Heqiang Wang, Xiang Liu, Xiaoxiong Zhong, Lixing Chen, Fangming Liu, Weizhe Zhang
arxiv-2505-16138.description: Abstract The Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystem generates vast amounts of multimodal data from heterogeneous sources such as sensors, cameras, and microphones. As edge intelligence continues to evolve, IoT devices have progressed from simple data collection units to nodes capable of executing complex computational tasks.

arxiv-2508-17994.title: A Retail-Corpus for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis with Large Language Models
arxiv-2508-17994.creator: Oleg Şilcenco, Marcos R. Machado, Wallace C. Ugulino, Daniel Braun
arxiv-2508-17994.description: Abstract Aspect-based sentiment analysis enhances sentiment detection by associating it with specific aspects, offering deeper insights than traditional sentiment analysis. This study introduces a manually annotated dataset of 10,814 multilingual customer reviews covering brick-and-mortar retail stores, labeled with eight aspect categories and their sentiment.

arxiv-2509-15337.title: Abundance anomalies in low mass field mergers as evidence of a merger origin for the second generation stars in globular clusters Preprint: V. Kravtsov
arxiv-2509-15337.creator: V. Kravtsov, S. Dib, F. Calderon
arxiv-2509-15337.description: Abstract Context. The canonical formation of second-generation (G2) stars in globular clusters (GCs) from gas enriched and ejected by G1 (primordial) polluters faces substantial challenges, i.e. (i) a mass-budget problem and (ii) uncertainty in the source(s) of the abundance anomaly of light elements (AALE) in G2 stars.

arxiv-2511-06899.title: RPTS: Tree-Structured Reasoning Process Scoring for Faithful Multimodal Evaluation
arxiv-2511-06899.creator: Haofeng Wang, Yu Zang
arxiv-2511-06899.description: Abstract Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) excel in multimodal reasoning and have shown impressive performance on various multimodal benchmarks. However, most of these benchmarks evaluate models primarily through multiple-choice or short-answer formats, which do not take the reasoning process into account.

arxiv-2511-09120.title: Differentially Private Rankings via Outranking Methods and Performance Data Aggregation
arxiv-2511-09120.creator: Luis Del Vasto-Terrientes
arxiv-2511-09120.description: Abstract Multiple-Criteria Decision Making (MCDM) is a sub-discipline of Operations Research that helps decision-makers in choosing, ranking, or sorting alternatives based on conflicting criteria. Over time, its application has been expanded into dynamic and data-driven domains, such as recommender systems.

arxiv-2601-21834.title: Reduction theorems for a conjecture on bases in source algebras of blocks of finite groups
arxiv-2601-21834.creator: Tiberiu Coconeţ, Constantin-Cosmin Todea
arxiv-2601-21834.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Tiberiu Coconeţ, Constantin-Cosmin Todea. The aim of this short research note is to present some results about a conjecture of Barker and Gelvin [ 3 , Conjecture 1.5 ] claiming that any source algebra of a p p -block ( p p is a prime) of a finite group has the unit group containing a basis stabilized by the left and right actions of the defect group.

arxiv-2603-16474.title: Practical MCTS-based Query Optimization: A Reproducibility Study and new MCTS algorithm for complex queries
arxiv-2603-16474.creator: Vladimir Burlakov, Alena Rybakina, Sergey Kudashev, Konstantin Gilev, Alexander Demin, Denis Ponomaryov, Yuriy Dorn

arxiv-2604-19403.creator: Yihong Chen, Pascal Fua

arxiv-2606-00995.creator: Camila Blank, Agam Bhatia, Senthooran Rajamanoharan, Arthur Conmy, Neel Nanda

pmc-10608777.title: Involvement of the Macrophage Migration Inhibitory Factor (MIF) in Lipedema
pmc-10608777.creator: Mauro Vasella, Stefan Wolf, Eamon C. Francis, Gerrit Grieb, Pablo Pfister, Gregory Reid, Jürgen Bernhagen, Nicole Lindenblatt, Epameinondas Gousopoulos, Bong-Sung Kim
pmc-10608777.description: Lipedema is a chronic disorder that mainly affects women. It is often misdiagnosed, and its etiology remains unknown. Recent research indicates an accumulation of macrophages and a shift in macrophage polarization in lipedema. One known protein superfamily that contributes to macrophage accumulation and polarization is the macrophage migration inhibitory factor (MIF) family.

pmc-11414032.title: The link between childhood physical activity enjoyment and adult kinesiophobia in individuals with chronic low back pain
pmc-11414032.creator: Haowei Liu, Hansen Li, Li Huang, Haodong Tian, Jinlong Wu, Qinwen Guan, Zhenhuan Wang, Xing Zhang, Zhou Yang, Li Peng
pmc-11414032.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to investigate the relationship between childhood physical activity enjoyment and current kinesiophobia among individuals with chronic low back pain (CLBP), considering the mediating influence of adult physical activity.MethodsWe recruited 648 adults (474 males, 174 females) with CLBP through an online platform. Of these, 99.1% (n = 642) were aged 18–60 years, and 0.

pmc-11430290.title: Neuronal Mechanisms of Reading Informational Texts in People with Different Levels of Mental Resilience
pmc-11430290.creator: Małgorzata Chojak, Anna Gawron, Marta Czechowska-Bieluga, Andrzej Różański, Ewa Sarzyńska-Mazurek, Anna Stachyra-Sokulska
pmc-11430290.description: The aim of this study was to verify whether the level of mental resilience would differentiate reading comprehension performance when using different information carriers. More than 150 people filled out a test regarding the level of resilience. They then participated in a survey using fNIRS. Their task was to read a one-page informational text and answer several questions.

pmc-11514079.title: Biomechanical and clinical outcomes after distal biceps tendon reattachment using an endo button technique and an interference screw
pmc-11514079.creator: Antoine Vanderlinden, Romain Carlat, Bruno Vincent, Christine Detrembleur, Serge Ayong
pmc-11514079.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundRupture of the long head of the distal bifid biceps tendon is a rare injury, for which surgical anatomical repair should be considered in active patients. The aim of this study was to review our patients who benefited from the EndoButton technique via a single anterior approach, comparing the clinical outcomes with the contralateral uninjured side and assessing their quality of life.

pmc-11590927.title: The Interaction of Positive and Negative Relationship Characteristics and Their Association with Relationship and Individual Health Outcomes in Older Couples
pmc-11590927.creator: Suzanne Bartle-Haring, Jie Hu, Lorraine Mion, Millie Ash, Pier Luigi Sacco
pmc-11590927.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The purpose of this study was to examine how positive and negative relationship characteristics and their interaction were predictive of global relationship happiness, psychological symptoms, and physical health in a large sample of older couples. The NSHAP Wave 2 partner data n = 955) were used to estimate both actor (within person) and partner (between person) effects using the Actor Partner Interdependence Model with Moderation.

pmc-12453261.title: CQ-CNN: A lightweight hybrid classical–quantum convolutional neural network for Alzheimer’s disease detection using 3D structural brain MRI
pmc-12453261.creator: Mominul Islam, Mohammad Junayed Hasan, M.R.C. Mahdy, Zeheng Wang, Zeheng Wang, Zeheng Wang, Zeheng Wang
pmc-12453261.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The automatic detection of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) using 3D volumetric MRI data is a complex, multi-domain challenge that has traditionally been addressed by training classical convolutional neural networks (CNNs). With the rise of quantum computing and its potential to replace classical systems in the future, there is a growing need to: (i) develop automated systems for AD detection that run on quantum computers, (ii) explore the capabilities of current-generation classical-quantum architectures, and (iii) identify their potential limitations and advantages.

pmc-12615607.title: Intelligent identification method for rice seedling growth stages and its application in laser supplementary lighting control research
pmc-12615607.creator: Xiaoyan Liu, Leijinyu Zhou, Bei Jiang, Helong Yu
pmc-12615607.description: Accurately identifying the growth stages of rice seedlings is crucial for managing factory nurseries and ensuring consistent seedling quality. This study introduces PGL-ShuffleNetV2, a lightweight and advanced model designed for efficient and accurate recognition of rice seedling growth stages. The proposed model achieves a streamlined architecture by: 1).

pmc-13146975.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1536 EVALUATION OF STROKE RESEARCH AT A DISTRICT GENERAL HOSPITAL IN NORTH LONDON
pmc-13146975.creator: Parvathy Oby Gopi, Aravinth Sivagnanaratnam
pmc-13146975.description: Background and aimsOur unit has involved in Stroke trials since its inspection of Hyper Acute Stroke Unit in 2010 there by providing our patients additional treatment and updated evidence-based care. However, District General Hospitals find it difficult to strike the balance between clinical load and conducting research with less staffing.

pmc-13233596.title: Therapeutic vaccines targeting solid tumors: A series of clinical trial analysis over the past decade
pmc-13233596.creator: Fengqi Qiu, Yilan Sun, Darren Wan-Teck Lim
pmc-13233596.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Highlights•Decade-long trials show cancer vaccines are safe, immunogenic, but weak as monotherapy.•ELISPOT-measured vaccine T-cell responses fail to predict clinical benefit.•mRNA vaccines and checkpoint inhibitor combinations are emerging translational strategies.•Future progress requires neoantigen personalization and functional immune biomarkers. Introduction

Therapeutic cancer vaccines represent a promising immunotherapeutic strategy designed to activate and expand tumor-specific immune responses in patients with established malignancies, in contrast to prophylactic vaccines that prevent virus-associated cancers [1].

pmc-13268880.title: Leveraging deep learning and explainable AI for effective liver tumor classification from CT scan images
pmc-13268880.creator: Meshal Alfarhood, Shatha Alotaibi, Aows Abuhaimed, Abdalrahman Alalwan
pmc-13268880.description: IntroductionCancer remains one of the leading causes of mortality worldwide, with 19.3 million new cases and 10 million deaths reported in 2020. According to the World Cancer Research Fund International (WCRF), liver cancer ranks as the fifth most prevalent cancer in men and the ninth in women.

pmc-13289841.title: Out-of-pocket costs for people with tuberculosis disease in Toronto, Canada: A web-based survey at two tuberculosis treatment centres, April 2023–April 2025
pmc-13289841.creator: Lauren Ramsay, Ezinne Ndukwe, Elizabeth Rea, Andrea Ackery, Jane McNamee, Thanh Nguyen, Marian Hassan, Nawang Yanga, Amrita Daftary, Kelly O’Brien, Christopher Pease, Yeva Sahakyan, Sarah Brode, Beate Sander
pmc-13289841.description: BackgroundIn Ontario, over 600 cases of tuberculosis (TB) have been reported annually since 2015. Despite publicly funded health care, the direct and indirect costs to individuals have not been well studied and may be substantial.ObjectiveTo assess the economic and social impacts of TB among individuals undergoing treatment at specialized TB care centers in Toronto, Canada.
